newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish police fear missing man kidnapped by ETA.
newsitem.headline: Spanish police fear missing man kidnapped by ETA.

text.p: Spanish police feared on Wednesday that Basque separatists may have kidnapped a businessman who has been missing since leaving work on Monday.
Cosme Delclaux Zubiria's family presented a missing person's report on Tuesday night.
"It looks bad," a Basque Interior Ministry source told the Spanish news agency Efe. But he added police were being prudent and had not yet officially declared it a kidnapping.
Delclaux, 34, works for the Integra Multimedia company in the northern Basque area of Vizcaya and belongs to a well-known financial and industrial family.
ETA (Basque Homeland and Freedom) has been holding prison officer Jose Antonio Ortega Lara for more than 300 days. It released businessman Jose Maria Aldaya in April after nearly a year of captivity.
ETA has killed some 800 people since 1968 in its drive for an independent Basque state. It has kidnapped 75 people since 1970, of whom 47 were linked to business and industry, said Efe.
